plan.failureSummary: The page.ai cached instruction replayed a stale positional CSS selector (`#nav > nav > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > button`) that now targets the 'Solutions' dropdown instead of 'Developers'. As a result, navigation to '/docs/' did not occur, causing the URL assertion to fail.
observedIndicators: Tool history and cached instructions show page.ai used `#nav > nav > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > button` which clicked 'Solutions' instead of 'Developers'.
Failure screenshot shows the 'Solutions' navigation dropdown open instead of the 'Developers' dropdown.
URL remained `https://www.checklyhq.com/` instead of `https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/`, causing the subsequent URL assertion to fail.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear page.ai cache and retry test
remediationSteps.details: Clear the cached page.ai instructions for checkly.test.ts so page.ai re-evaluates the page DOM dynamically and selects the correct 'Developers' menu item.

plan.notes: The test failure is caused by stale cached page.ai instructions. Clearing the cache will allow page.ai to locate the updated 'Developers' menu element and successfully navigate to the documentation page.
